statement: ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.mul (fun k => -f (-k)) (fun k => -g (-k)) = fun k => KdVPlan.mul f g (-k)
proof:
intro f g
funext k
unfold KdVPlan.mul
have he := (Equiv.neg ℤ).tsum_eq (fun j : ℤ => f j * g (-k-j))
change (∑' j : ℤ, -f (-j) * -g (-(k-j))) = ∑' j : ℤ, f j * g (-k-j)
calc
  _ = ∑' j : ℤ, f (-j) * g (-k-(-j)) := by
    apply tsum_congr
    intro j
    simp only [neg_mul_neg]
    congr 2
    omega
  _ = _ := he
